messages:
Anya S.: Heads-up — AcmeCorp (Dedicated) just flagged an unexpected overage invoice. They have a reserved capacity contract but burst traffic last week caused multiple overage lines and they want a per-token breakdown + credits for the spike. Asking for product triage.

Sam K.: +1. Sales already flagged to me — customer is frustrated. They signed a 3mo reserved commit (4k tokens/min) and saw a large bill for May. Asking if we can issue a one-time credit while we investigate.

Jordan T.: Can you paste the invoice snippet and the time windows for the spikes? Need: route(s) used, model, seq lengths, and whether fallback routing triggered.

Anya S.: Invoice snippet below (redacted):
```
reserved_commitment: $10,000/month
overage_charges: $3,478.50
overage_detail: 12,345 tokens @ $0.000282 = $3.4785
period: 2025-08-04 02:00 -> 2025-08-04 06:00 UTC
routes: api/chat (default), model: open-redwood-xl-v1
```
Also customer says their app had a sudden retry storm when upstream DB timed out, so traffic concentrated in a 30m window.

Maria P.: Likely a burst where our continuous batching bumped them into new per-minute utilization. Did they have any routing policy that should have fallen back to a cheaper model?

Anya S.: They were pinned to open-redwood-xl-v1 for quality reasons. No fallback policy in their config.

Lee W.: From finance perspective: we can do a manual goodwill credit but need rationale + cap. Suggest temporary cap $5k for sales approval; anything above requires director ok. Also need to confirm our published overage rate vs hosted rate — customer claims they were charged at ~2x hosted.

pricing-bot: Based on contract and observed tokens, recommended one-time credit = min( max( overage_charges * 0.9, 500 ), 5000 ) => $3,130 (rounded). Basis: 90% goodwill for operational incident; preserves incentive to set fallbacks.

Jordan T.: Proposed triage + follow-ups:
- Immediate: PM-approved goodwill credit up to $5k and note to customer explaining cause (owner: Jordan).
- Short term (1 sprint): add a "reserved-capacity overage" alert in Console and expose per-route minute-level token histogram (owner: Eng-Product / Maria).
- Medium (Q4): update docs and billing FAQ plus add an auto-fallback policy toggle for Dedicated that can switch to compatible smaller models during bursts (owner: Product + Runtime).

Sam K.: I'll get customer sign-off for a credit and send a short note. Can we draft the customer message here? Something like: "We're sorry — we've reviewed your invoice and will apply a one-time credit while we add monitoring and recommend config changes to avoid future overages."

Maria P.: For the Console work I need the exact metric we want. Suggest: per-route tokens_per_minute 95th percentile and a burst_flag if > x * reserved_commitment for 3 consecutive minutes. I can prototype in this sprint.

Lee W.: Also file a short ledger entry for manual credit so Finance can track (please include ticket id). If credit > $2k loop in legal for amendment language.

Jordan T.: I'll create a product ticket with acceptance criteria: reproduction steps using sample load, UX copy for the alert, owner assignments, and rollout plan. Jordan -> ticket #PRD-472.

Anya S.: Thanks all. Next steps: Sam will confirm customer accepts the one-time credit, Jordan will open PRD-472, Maria to start prototype for alert, Lee to prepare finance entry. I'll update thread when customer confirms. :thumbsup:

Sam K.: On it, pinging the AE.

pricing-bot: Logged suggested credit to PRD-472 (internal note).

Anya S.: Customer accepted the credit via email at 2025-08-04T18:12Z. Applying $3,130 credit now. Closing loop with customer and will attach PRD-472 once live.

Jordan T.: Marking owners and moving PRD-472 into In Progress. Thanks team. :rocket:
